verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at airwallex.com, and a docs-level llms.txt exists too. Airwallex also publishes per-page .md docs, dedicated "Instructions for AI agents" pages written for machine consumption, and an unauthenticated Docs MCP that connects coding agents to its documentation. missing for 10: root /docs.md returns 404, and there is no independent or community corroboration of how well agents perform with these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: requires no authentication and is safe to add to any agent
connects AI coding agents — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools — to Airwallex documentation and the Airwallex sandbox
